name: ATLAS Bridge
description: Send page context to ATLAS overlay

_comments_F11.debugger: REQUIRED for chrome.debugger.attach + Runtime.evaluate fallback in background.js (~line 1203) — this is the only reliable way to run page-context JS on strict-CSP sites like Gmail/GitHub where chrome.scripting.executeScript world:MAIN fails. Also gates the rawCDP() pass-through with CDP_ALLOWED_METHODS allowlist (Input.insertText, DOM.setFileInputFiles, Page.captureScreenshot, Accessibility.getFullAXTree). Cannot drop without losing AX-tree extraction + CSP-safe JS injection.
_comments_F11.host_permissions: <all_urls> is required because the agent operates on whatever tab the user is on — we cannot enumerate a finite host list at install time. activeTab is insufficient: it only grants access on user-gesture-initiated invocations, not the agent-driven flows where the operator says 'use my Gmail tab' programmatically. Content-script injection is gated by chrome.tabs.query at runtime; debugger access requires explicit chrome.debugger.attach which surfaces an OS-level 'A.T.L.A.S started debugging this browser' banner.
